## Validation

<!-- List exact commands, fixtures, platforms, measurements, or screenshots. -->

- [ ] Automated tests added or updated
- [ ] Failure and edge cases covered
- [ ] Interchange claims have provenance (or are explicitly synthetic)
- [ ] UI changes checked for keyboard use and readable contrast
- [ ] `npm run test:run` and `npm run build` pass

## Compatibility, safety, and data

- [ ] No public schema or file-format break without versioning
- [ ] Failed / unknown / do-not-advise results cannot appear as successful matches
- [ ] New dependencies and data have documented license and provenance
- [ ] No secrets or non-redistributable catalogs included

## Documentation and release note

- [ ] User and contributor documentation updated when needed
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated, or this change has no user-visible effect
